scripts.build: pnpm generate && pnpm build:reference && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.lint:openapi: spectral lint openapi.yaml --ruleset .spectral.yaml --fail-severity warn && spectral lint "mock-*.openapi.json" --ruleset .spectral.mock.yaml --fail-severity warn && spectral lint signal-worker.v1.openapi.json --ruleset .spectral.worker.yaml --fail-severity warn && spectral lint assistant.v1.openapi.json --ruleset .spectral.assistant.yaml --fail-severity warn
scripts.generate: pnpm generate:actions && openapi-typescript openapi.yaml -o src/generated/api.ts && pnpm generate:signal && pnpm generate:risk && pnpm generate:domain-packs
scripts.generate:signal: node scripts/generate-signal.mjs && node scripts/generate-worker.mjs && openapi-typescript signal-worker.v1.openapi.json -o src/generated/worker-api.ts
